notablePrerequisites: Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Charnelhoard Wurm.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.
